jurisdictions.name: Netherlands
jurisdictions.structure_note: One national regime: income tax, the Box 3 deemed-return tax and inheritance tax are set nationally for the whole country. Only the municipal property tax (OZB) differs by municipality, and it is not counted. European Netherlands only.

Dividend tax is 15% of the proceeds (Art. 5 Wet op de dividendbelasting 1965). A conditional withholding tax of 25.8% (the top corporate rate, Art. 4.1 Wet bronbelasting 2021) applies only to payments to affiliated companies in listed low-tax or non-cooperative jurisdictions and in certain abuse situations, not to individuals.

No general withholding tax on interest. The only Dutch withholding on interest is the conditional tax (25.8%, the top corporate rate) on payments to affiliated companies in listed low-tax or non-cooperative jurisdictions and in certain abuse situations.

rates.thr_note: Tax-free allowance per person (double for fiscal partners); debts count above €3,800 per person.
rates.note: Box 3 is an income tax on a deemed return, not a wealth tax in name, and it works as one. Effective rate = 36% x the deemed return: 2.16% of net assets above the allowance on investments and other assets (36% x 6%), 0.461% on bank balances (36% x 1.28%). Debts are deducted at 2.7% (savings and debt percentages provisional until early 2027). The effective rates are derived from the stated percentages.
